summary: Keep checkpoint conflicts moving through receipt and preserve owned-set exclusions across chunks.

replay.detail: Reader-side conflict discovery includes checkpoint receipts and is bounded by the pass target. A durable watermark and conflict evidence set avoid rescanning the log on each receipt; metadata commits in bounded pages. Writer-side replay fences consult indexed evidence only. The first upgraded pass scans historical claims once, outside the writer.

rules.detail: Canonical registry and graph fold rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Each receipt loads durable degraded owned-set identities before applying set members, so a later unrelated chunk cannot silently repair an excluded set.

manual.detail: Explicit repair remains required for excluded sets and deferred replay.

recovery.detail: Checkpoint-conflict receipt no longer remains stuck behind the no-replay fence; owned-set degradation persists until explicit repair. Deferred replay keeps graph health stale and recovery required even as the frontier advances. A successful explicit replay_replication_graph clears the deferred row.

downtime.detail: No production timing measurement is claimed.
